arxiv-2110-06217.title: Low-Energy Signals from the Formation of Dark Matter-Nuclear Bound States
arxiv-2110-06217.creator: Asher Berlin, Hongwan Liu, Maxim Pospelov, Harikrishnan Ramani
arxiv-2110-06217.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Asher Berlin, Hongwan Liu, Maxim Pospelov, Harikrishnan Ramani. Dark matter particles may bind with nuclei if there exists an attractive force of sufficient strength. We show that a dark photon mediator of mass ∼ ( 10 − 100 ) ​ MeV \sim(10-100)\ \text{MeV} that kinetically mixes with Standard Model electromagnetism at the level of ∼ 10 − 3 \sim 10^{-3} generates keV-scale binding energies between dark matter and heavy elements, while forbidding the ability to bind with light elements.

arxiv-2208-01775.title: A convergence rate of the discrepancy for Allen-Cahn type equations
arxiv-2208-01775.creator: Kazuhiro HORIHATA
arxiv-2208-01775.description: Abstract abstract. This paper presents a new partial differential equation to build Brakke’s motion, which is a weak notion of mean curvature flow. We call the equation a modified Allen-Cahn equation abbreviated to MAC . After that we introduce its benefit: An improved estimate on the discrepant energy that means the equipartition of the first energy.

arxiv-2312-00578.title: Two new non-equivalent three-qubit CHSH games
arxiv-2312-00578.creator: Hamza Jaffali, Frédéric Holweck
arxiv-2312-00578.description: Abstract In this paper, we generalize to three players the well-known CHSH quantum game. To do so, we consider all possible 3 variables Boolean functions and search among them which ones correspond to a game scenario with a quantum advantage (for a given entangled state).

arxiv-2504-12585.title: Identifying and Mitigating the Influence of the Prior Distribution in Large Language Models
arxiv-2504-12585.creator: Liyi Zhang, Veniamin Veselovsky, R. Thomas McCoy, Thomas L. Griffiths
arxiv-2504-12585.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Liyi Zhang, Veniamin Veselovsky, R. Thomas McCoy, Thomas L. Griffiths. Large language models (LLMs) sometimes fail to respond appropriately to deterministic tasks – such as counting or forming acronyms – because the implicit prior distribution they have learned over sequences of tokens influences their responses. In this work, we show that, in at least some cases, LLMs actually compute the information needed to perform these tasks correctly, and we identify some interventions that can allow them to access this information to improve their performance.

pmc-11313536.title: Incorporation of Nano-Zinc Oxide as a Strategy to Improve the Barrier Properties of Biopolymer–Suberinic Acid Residues Films: A Preliminary Study
pmc-11313536.creator: Aleksandra Jeżo, Faksawat Poohphajai, Rene Herrera Diaz, Grzegorz Kowaluk, Giuseppe Mele
pmc-11313536.description: Finishing coatings in the wood-based composites industry not only influence the final appearance of the product but also serve to protect against fungi and molds and reduce the release of harmful substances, particularly formaldehyde and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). Carbon-rich materials, such as those derived from birch bark extraction, specifically suberin acids, can fulfill this role.

pmc-11354281.title: Molecular Detection and Analysis of Trypanosoma (Megatrypanum) spp. Diversity in Tabanidae (Diptera) Collected in Lithuania
pmc-11354281.creator: Jurga Turčinavičienė, Rasa Bernotienė, Andrius Petrašiūnas
pmc-11354281.description: Simple SummaryHorse flies are known as vectors of various species of trypanosomatids. The aim of this study was to investigate Trypanosoma in the Tabanidae family collected in different localities in Lithuania. Our objectives were to examine the genetic diversity of Trypanosoma sp. detected in tabanids, assessing the relationships between parasite lineages and tabanid species.

pmc-11641396.title: Qigong Therapy for Stress Management: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-11641396.creator: Jung-Ho Oh, Soo-Hyun Sung, Jang-Kyung Park, Soobin Jang, Byung-Cheul Shin, Sangnam Lee, Ines Aguinaga-Ontoso, Luís Carlos Matos

Background/objective: Althouth Qigong is commonly used to manage stress, anxiety, and depression, there have been no systematic reviews on Qigong therapy for stress management. This study aimed to analyze the clinical evidence of Qigong therapy for perceived stress.

pmc-12456641.title: Large left internal jugular vein determined during cardiac surgery: A case report
pmc-12456641.creator: Kadİrİye S. Elden, Helİn Ozler, Hasan Hepaguslar
pmc-12456641.description: This case report presents the significant enlargement of the left internal jugular vein (IJV) detected during ultrasound (US)-guided central venous catheterization (CVC) in an adult patient undergoing cardiac surgery. An 81-year-old female patient who had severe mitral valve regurgitation, severe tricuspid valve regurgitation, and pulmonary hypertension was scheduled for Mitral Valve Replacement and DeVega Tricuspidoplasty.

pmc-12652085.title: Hydrogel Design Based on Bacterial Exopolysaccharides: The Biomedical Promise of Levan
pmc-12652085.creator: Andrada Ioana Popa, Rahela Carpa, Anca Farkas
pmc-12652085.description: Bacterial exopolysaccharides have emerged as versatile biopolymers for the design of advanced hydrogels with adjustable physico-chemical, mechanical, and biological properties. Among these, levan, a fructose-based exopolysaccharide synthesized by various microbial species, has attracted increasing attention due to its unique structural features, high biocompatibility, and inherent bioactivity.

pmc-12750930.title: A theoretical model of secular body mass index dynamics among Russian adults under changing socio-economic conditions
pmc-12750930.creator: Marina A Negasheva, Olga A Kuznetsova, Ainur A Khafizova, Alla A Movsesian
pmc-12750930.description: BackgroundBody mass index (BMI) is a key indicator of population health and often shifts alongside socio-economic change. Few studies have tracked these dynamics over long periods in transitional economies. Russia’s late-twentieth-century transformations offer a rare opportunity to examine such links.

pmc-12817637.title: Laser biospeckles as a speedy tool to investigate the effects of sound on lentil (Lens esculenta puyensis) seeds
pmc-12817637.creator: Uma Maheswari Rajagopalan, Ayato Suzuki, Takeshi Baba, Takahiro Kono, Jun Yamada, Hirofumi Kadono
pmc-12817637.description: ObjectiveWe propose the application of laser biospeckles—a non-destructive, non-contact, real-time technique—to investigate the effect of sound pressure levels and different frequency sounds on lentil (Lens esculenta puyensis) seeds. Lentil seeds were illuminated by a laser diode source with a wavelength of 630 nm, and biospeckle patterns resulting from the interference of scattered laser light were captured as time-sequenced image frames.

pmc-13182031.title: Enzymatic activity screening in marine bacteria exposed to oxo-polyethylene in artificial marine microcosms
pmc-13182031.creator: Watumesa Agustina Tan, Felicia Felicia, Lois Bunga Lestari, Adi Yulandi
pmc-13182031.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesOxo-polyethylene (oxo-PE) is marketed as a biodegradable plastic, yet its environmental degradation remains poorly understood, particularly in marine contexts. This study aimed to screen for bacterial isolates with enzymatic potential relevant to oxo-PE breakdown using a simulated marine environment. Microbial communities were enriched in Winogradsky columns containing oxo-PE sheets, and isolates were screened for enzymes known to contribute to polymer breakdown.ResultsAfter 60 days of incubation, no significant weight loss was detected in oxo-PE sheets.

pmc-13197125.title: Clinical and pathologic correlations of machine learning quantification of Aβ deposits across 3 brain regions of decedents with Alzheimer disease
pmc-13197125.creator: David Garcia, Shivam Rajendra Rai Sharma, Naomi Saito, Laurel Beckett, Louise Nicole C Sevilla, La Rissa Vasquez, Charles S DeCarli, David Gutman, Juan Vizcarra, David G Coughlin, Andrew F Teich, Lorena Garcia, Dan M Mungas, Chen-Nee Chuah, Brittany N Dugger
pmc-13197125.description: Machine learning enables scalable quantification of neuropathology, offering deeper phenotyping of Alzheimer’s disease (AD). In this validation study, we quantified amyloid-beta (Aβ) deposits, evaluating multiple brain regions across institutions, and evaluated associations with clinical, demographic, and genetic factors in persons pathologically diagnosed with AD. All linear models were adjusted for sex, age of death, ethnicity, and center.

Sheridan, Michael David, Salvador Amaral, Luzia Freitas, Anthony DK Draper, Nevio Sarmento, Endang Soares da Silva, L
pmc-13669370.description: Dengue virus (DENV) infection causes significant morbidity and mortality across tropical and sub-tropical regions, including in Timor-Leste. In this study we present the results of a national, population-representative serological survey, used to determine the drivers of observed variations in DENV force-of-infection (FOI, i.e. the average annual per-capita risk of infection for a susceptible person) at high spatial resolution.
